thread:
alex: Heads-up — proposing a telemetry.events compactification for Console. Main changes: rename `route_id` -> `route_key`, collapse `route_tags` into a sparse JSONB `meta` column, and drop the heavy `route_profile` join for common queries. This should cut storage and speed up dashboard queries, but will touch quota lookups and routing policy joins.

maria: do we have an estimate on how many queries rely on `route_profile` today? dashboards + quota calcs? :thinking_face:

jun: rough ballpark: ~22% of console p99 queries join route_profile on the hot path. Quota code paths are another ~12% (some cached). If we remove the join we need either a read-adapter or hydrate a denormed field for quota windows.

sophie: big UX ask: any schema change that affects per-route charts must be backcompatible for dashboards. We should have a canary that serves dashboards from both shapes and compares p99/P50 + totals.

alex: agree on canary. plan I'm thinking: dual-write during migration window, introduce `meta->>'quota_window'` denorm for quick lookup, and a read-adapter that can answer both shapes. Backfill job for old rows to populate `meta` gradually.

maria: we should be explicit about quota semantics — if we denorm `quota_window` we must ensure it stays authoritative. Otherwise drift will break billing. Suggest a lightweight consistency checker.

jun: +1 on checker. Also we need a migration strategy for routing policies where the router currently keys on `route_id`. We'll accept `route_key` but need a mapping table during transition. 

sophie: for rollout UX: add a Console flag per-tenant to opt into new shape (so SRE/CS can toggle for customers that hit regressions). Also surface a migration health panel (rows backfilled, errors, lag).

alex: decided: three phases — 1) schema add and dual-write (no reads), 2) read-adapter opt-in (canary), 3) cutover and backfill completion. We'll keep `route_profile` join for 30 days post-cutover as rollback safety.

deploy-bot: migration-runner started job 4940001111-01

```
-- add column
ALTER TABLE telemetry.events ADD COLUMN meta JSONB;
ALTER TABLE telemetry.events ADD COLUMN route_key TEXT;
-- dual-write hooks enabled in ingest
```

jun: Q: how heavy is the dual-write? If ingest path is hot we need to avoid sync stalls. Maybe async background writer with idempotent semantics.

maria: also need quota recalculation windows for customers during the backfill. We can't re-bill retroactively without consent. Recommend we only use denorm for read-paths initially and keep billing on the source-of-truth `route_profile` until final cutover.

sophie: can we do periodic shadow-reads to detect discrepancies? i.e., compute quota from both sides for a sample of tenants and compute deltas. Show diffs in migration health panel. :bar_chart:

ajun: (ops) My ops concern: indexing. We'll need a GIN index on `meta` for route tag lookups and a btree index on `route_key`. Those will take time to build; plan to build concurrently.

alex: concur. add to runbook: concurrent index builds, monitor replica lag, and limit concurrency on backfill workers by tenant.

maria: I'll write the billing safety checklist: no billing cutover until discrepancy < 0.1% for 7 days across sampled tenants. Also need support runbook for customers who opt-out.

sophie: I can add the console toggles and health panel mockups — will ship prototype in the dashboard repo.

jun: final note: API compatibility — internal endpoints that return route metadata must accept both `route_id` and `route_key`. I'll add a compatibility shim in routing-service for 60 days.

alex: thanks all — I'll open the migration PR with the phased plan and runbook. tagging ops and billing to review the safety checklist. :raised_hands:
